rows.definition: The internal/model session policy that admits inference only when the active compute backend has device memory and every architecture-specific operation needed by that session remains on the device; an attempted host-compute fallback records the observation, retires the session, and returns the typed backend-operation refusal.
rows.distinction: It governs where model arithmetic executes after a backend is selected, not the adjudicator Policy that authorizes agent tool calls and not ExpertTierPolicy, which moves expert weights between host cache tiers.

rows.definition: The internal/model Session mutator that pins the compute-residency policy before inference and propagates that choice through prefix snapshots, cloned sessions, restored sessions, and retained MTP draft sessions.
rows.distinction: It configures one decoder session's model-compute residency contract; Adjudicator.SetPolicy instead replaces the process's live tool-authorization decision table.
